Mctt.Core.Semantic.Rename

Renaming the Levels of Values: Readback Commutes with Weakening

A value names variables by de Bruijn *level* (d_var x); readback at length s turns the level x into the index s - x - 1. So the same value read back at s and at S s gives two normal forms that differ by the weakening ↑ — provided the value only mentions levels below s (read_shift). This is the step "readback at |Γ| + 1 is the weakening of readback at |Γ|" of the semantic proof that NbE commutes with weakening (Core.NbEWeakening).
The two readbacks do not run in lockstep on the *same* value: under a binder, readback at s applies the closure to the fresh level s, and readback at S s to the fresh level S s. So the statement is generalised to a renaming f of levels, applied to values by drn f:
  • evaluation is equivariant under every f (eval_rn): it never looks at a level, it only carries them;
  • readback of drn f d at s' is the readback of d at s, renamed by a weakening φ that sends the index of x at s to the index of f x at s' (read_rn). For the canonical form of a level this needs φ to preserve the order of indices (Core.Syntactic.NfRename.lvl_canon_wk).
read_shift is the instance f x = x below s and f x = S x from s on: it fixes the initial environment of a context of length s, and so every value evaluated in it.
That readback only meets levels below s is the invariant dav of Core.Semantic.Avoid, at every excluded level v ≥ s (dbd).
From Stdlib Require Import Arith Lia List PeanoNat String.

From Mctt Require Import LibTactics.
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Import NbE Avoid.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Import Fresh Members NfRename.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic.Inductives Require Import Inductives.

The Renaming


Section Rename.
  Variable f : nat -> nat.

A value with every de Bruijn level renamed by f, closures' environments included; mutually, for the other sorts of values.
  Fixpoint drn (d : domain) : domain :=
    match d with
    | d_pi a ρ B => d_pi (drn a) (List.map dern ρ) B
    | d_univ i => d_univ i
    | d_suniv l => d_suniv (drn l)
    | d_level n => d_level n
    | d_lvl c xs => d_lvl c (List.map (fun ka => match ka with (k, n, m) => (k, n, drn_ne m) end) xs)
    | d_True => d_True
    | d_true => d_true
    | d_False => d_False
    | d_fn ρ M => d_fn (List.map dern ρ) M
    | d_neut a m => d_neut (drn a) (drn_ne m)
    | d_member h ch => d_member (dmrn h) ch
    | d_ind p k args => d_ind p k (List.map drn args)
    | d_con p k c args => d_con p k c (List.map drn args)
    | d_ihfn ρ Bks p ups t g => d_ihfn (List.map dern ρ) Bks p (List.map drn ups) t (drn g)
    | d_shfam p ups ρ t => d_shfam p (List.map drn ups) (List.map dern ρ) t
    | d_ihfam ρm As ρ t g => d_ihfam (List.map dern ρm) As (List.map dern ρ) t (drn g)
    end
  with drn_ne (m : domain_ne) : domain_ne :=
    match m with
    | d_var x => d_var (f x)
    | d_app m n => d_app (drn_ne m) (drn_nf n)
    | d_exfalso ρ A m => d_exfalso (List.map dern ρ) A (drn_ne m)
    | d_elim ρ Bks p ups j args m =>
        d_elim (List.map dern ρ) Bks p (List.map drn ups) j (List.map drn args) (drn_ne m)
    | d_glob p => d_glob p
    end
  with drn_nf (n : domain_nf) : domain_nf :=
    match n with
    | d_dom a m => d_dom (drn a) (drn m)
    end
  with dmrn (h : dmod) : dmod :=
    match h with
    | dm_global p args => dm_global p (List.map drn args)
    | dm_local Δ D ρ => dm_local Δ D (List.map dern ρ)
    | dm_member h ch => dm_member (dmrn h) ch
    end
  with dern (e : dentry) : dentry :=
    match e with
    | de_term d => de_term (drn d)
    | de_mod h => de_mod (dmrn h)
    end.

  Definition ern (ρ : env) : env := List.map dern ρ.
  Definition larn (xs : list (nat * nat * domain_ne)) : list (nat * nat * domain_ne) :=
    List.map (fun ka => match ka with (k, n, m) => (k, n, drn_ne m) end) xs.

  Lemma drn_lvl : forall c xs, drn (d_lvl c xs) = d_lvl c (larn xs).
  Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma ern_cons : forall e ρ, ern (e :: ρ) = dern e :: ern ρ.
  Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma ern_nil : ern nil = nil.
  Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma env_entry_rn : forall ρ x, env_entry (ern ρ) x = dern (env_entry ρ x).
  Proof.
    intros; rewrite !env_entry_nth; unfold ern.
    change (de_term d_true) with (dern (de_term d_true)) at 1.
    apply List.map_nth.
  Qed.

  Lemma env_var_rn : forall ρ x, env_var (ern ρ) x = drn (env_var ρ x).
  Proof. intros; unfold env_var; rewrite env_entry_rn; destruct (env_entry ρ x); reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma env_mod_rn : forall ρ x, env_mod (ern ρ) x = dmrn (env_mod ρ x).
  Proof. intros; unfold env_mod; rewrite env_entry_rn; destruct (env_entry ρ x); reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma env_args_rn : forall args ρ, ern (env_args ρ args) = env_args (ern ρ) (List.map drn args).
  Proof. induction args; intros; cbn; [ reflexivity | apply IHargs ]. Qed.

  Lemma dsort_rn : forall d, dsort (drn d) = dsort d.
  Proof. destruct d; reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma dlvl_view_rn : forall d, dlvl_view (drn d) = (fst (dlvl_view d), larn (snd (dlvl_view d))).
  Proof. destruct d; cbn; try reflexivity; rewrite dsort_rn; reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma dlvl_suc_rn : forall d, drn (dlvl_suc d) = dlvl_suc (drn d).
  Proof.
    intros; unfold dlvl_suc, dlvl_cst, dlvl_atoms; rewrite dlvl_view_rn, drn_lvl; cbn [fst snd]; f_equal.
    unfold larn; rewrite !List.map_map; apply List.map_ext; intros [[] ?]; reflexivity.
  Qed.

  Lemma dlvl_max_rn : forall d e, drn (dlvl_max d e) = dlvl_max (drn d) (drn e).
  Proof.
    intros; unfold dlvl_max, dlvl_cst, dlvl_atoms; rewrite !dlvl_view_rn, drn_lvl; cbn [fst snd]; f_equal.
    unfold larn; apply List.map_app.
  Qed.

  Lemma length_ern : forall ρ, List.length (ern ρ) = List.length ρ.
  Proof. intros; apply List.length_map. Qed.

The group of an eliminator is read off the head of a value, which the renaming keeps.
  Lemma elim_grp_of_rn : forall oq m, elim_grp_of oq (drn m) = elim_grp_of oq m.
  Proof.
    intros [p |] m; [ reflexivity |].
    destruct m; try reflexivity.
    match goal with |- elim_grp_of _ (drn (d_neut ?a _)) = _ => destruct a; reflexivity end.
  Qed.
End Rename.

Evaluation Is Equivariant


Create Rewrite HintDb rn.

Section Eval.
  Variables (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (f : nat -> nat).

  #[local] Hint Rewrite env_var_rn env_mod_rn env_args_rn dlvl_suc_rn dlvl_max_rn
    List.map_app List.length_map List.firstn_map List.skipn_map : rn.

  Lemma kpad_rn : forall n ρ, ern f (kpad n ρ) = kpad n (ern f ρ).
  Proof. intros; unfold kpad, ern; rewrite List.map_app; f_equal; induction n; cbn; f_equal; assumption. Qed.

  Lemma kbentry_rn : forall ρ E, dern f (kbentry ρ E) = kbentry (ern f ρ) E.
  Proof. intros ρ [? ? ? ? | ? [] | ? ? ? ? | ? ? ? ?]; reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma kgens_env_rn : forall gs ρ k, ern f (kgens_env ρ k gs) = kgens_env (ern f ρ) k gs.
  Proof.
    induction gs as [| g gs IH]; intros; cbn [kgens_env]; [ reflexivity |].
    rewrite IH; f_equal; destruct g; reflexivity.
  Qed.

Kinds read no level.
  Lemma kind_rn :
    (forall h ch k, dkind Θ Ξ h ch k -> dkind Θ Ξ (dmrn f h) ch k) /\
    (forall ρ U ch k, ukind Θ Ξ ρ U ch k -> ukind Θ Ξ (ern f ρ) U ch k) /\
    (forall ρ H ch k, skind Θ Ξ ρ H ch k -> skind Θ Ξ (ern f ρ) H ch k) /\
    (forall ρ Φ ρ', kenv Θ Ξ ρ Φ ρ' -> kenv Θ Ξ (ern f ρ) Φ (ern f ρ')) /\
    (forall ρ Φ Φx, kbody Θ Ξ ρ Φ Φx -> kbody Θ Ξ (ern f ρ) Φ Φx) /\
    (forall ρ H its gs, kgens Θ Ξ ρ H its gs -> kgens Θ Ξ (ern f ρ) H its gs).
  Proof.
    apply kind_mut_ind; intros; cbn [dmrn ern List.map dern drn] in *;
      repeat change (List.map (dern f) ?ρ) with (ern f ρ) in *;
      rewrite ?kpad_rn in *; try rewrite <- kpad_rn in *;
      try solve [ econstructor; eauto ].
    all: try solve [ rewrite kgens_env_rn; econstructor; eauto ].
    all: try solve [ rewrite kbentry_rn; econstructor; eauto ].
    all: try solve [ econstructor; [ eassumption | rewrite <- kpad_rn; eassumption | eassumption ] ].
    all: try solve [ econstructor; rewrite <- kpad_rn; eassumption ].
    all: try solve [ econstructor; rewrite env_mod_rn; eassumption ].
    all: try solve [ eapply uk_item_mod; [ eassumption | rewrite <- kpad_rn; eassumption | eassumption | eassumption ] ].
  Qed.

  Lemma eval_rn :
    (forall M ρ m, ⟦ M ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ m -> ⟦ M ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f m) /\
    (forall m n r, $| m & n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> $| drn f m & drn f n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r) /\
    (forall Ms ρ ms, ⟦ Ms ⟧* Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ ms -> ⟦ Ms ⟧* Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ List.map (drn f) ms) /\
    (forall m args r, $*| m & args | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> $*| drn f m & List.map (drn f) args | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r) /\
    (forall H ρ h, ⟦ H ⟧ᵐ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ h -> ⟦ H ⟧ᵐ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ dmrn f h) /\
    (forall Δ D ρ h, ⟦ Δ ⊢ D ⟧ᶜ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ h -> ⟦ Δ ⊢ D ⟧ᶜ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ dmrn f h) /\
    (forall h n r, $ᵐ| h & n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> $ᵐ| dmrn f h & drn f n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ dmrn f r) /\
    (forall h ns r, $ᵐ*| h & ns | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> $ᵐ*| dmrn f h & List.map (drn f) ns | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ dmrn f r) /\
    (forall h x r, h ·ₜ x Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> dmrn f h ·ₜ x Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r) /\
    (forall h y r, h ·ₘ y Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> dmrn f h ·ₘ y Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ dmrn f r) /\
    (forall h ch r, h ·ₜ* ch Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> dmrn f h ·ₜ* ch Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r) /\
    (forall h ch r, h ·ₘ* ch Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> dmrn f h ·ₘ* ch Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ dmrn f r) /\
    (forall ρ Φ ρ', ⟦ Φ ⟧ᵇ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ ρ' -> ⟦ Φ ⟧ᵇ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ ern f ρ') /\
    (forall ρ p ups Bks j m r, ⟦elim m at j of p ups Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ r ->
       ⟦elim drn f m at j of p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f r) /\
    (forall ρ p ups Bks gs vs ihs, ⟦ihs vs of gs under p ups Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ ihs ->
       ⟦ihs List.map (drn f) vs of gs under p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ List.map (drn f) ihs) /\
    (forall ρ p ups Bks t m r, ⟦ih m of t under p ups Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ r ->
       ⟦ih drn f m of t under p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f r) /\
    (forall p ups j r, ⟦mref j of p ups ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r ->
       ⟦mref j of p (List.map (drn f) ups) ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ (fst (fst r), snd (fst r), List.map (drn f) (snd r))) /\
    (forall p ups ρ t a, ⟦shty t of p ups ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ a -> ⟦shty t of p (List.map (drn f) ups) ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f a) /\
    (forall ρm As ρ t m a, ⟦ihty m of t under ρm As ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ a -> ⟦ihty drn f m of t under (ern f ρm) As ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f a).
  Proof.
    apply (eval_mut_ind Θ Ξ
             (fun M ρ m _ => ⟦ M ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f m)
             (fun m n r _ => $| drn f m & drn f n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r)
             (fun Ms ρ ms _ => ⟦ Ms ⟧* Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ List.map (drn f) ms)
             (fun m args r _ => $*| drn f m & List.map (drn f) args | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r)
             (fun H ρ h _ => ⟦ H ⟧ᵐ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ dmrn f h)
             (fun Δ D ρ h _ => ⟦ Δ ⊢ D ⟧ᶜ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ dmrn f h)
             (fun h n r _ => $ᵐ| dmrn f h & drn f n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ dmrn f r)
             (fun h ns r _ => $ᵐ*| dmrn f h & List.map (drn f) ns | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ dmrn f r)
             (fun h x r _ => dmrn f h ·ₜ x Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r)
             (fun h y r _ => dmrn f h ·ₘ y Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ dmrn f r)
             (fun h ch r _ => dmrn f h ·ₜ* ch Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r)
             (fun h ch r _ => dmrn f h ·ₘ* ch Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ dmrn f r)
             (fun ρ Φ ρ' _ => ⟦ Φ ⟧ᵇ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ ern f ρ')
             (fun ρ p ups Bks j m r _ => ⟦elim drn f m at j of p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f r)
             (fun ρ p ups Bks gs vs ihs _ =>
                ⟦ihs List.map (drn f) vs of gs under p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ List.map (drn f) ihs)
             (fun ρ p ups Bks t m r _ => ⟦ih drn f m of t under p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f r)
             (fun p ups j r _ => ⟦mref j of p (List.map (drn f) ups) ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ (fst (fst r), snd (fst r), List.map (drn f) (snd r)))
             (fun p ups ρ t a _ => ⟦shty t of p (List.map (drn f) ups) ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f a)
             (fun ρm As ρ t m a _ => ⟦ihty drn f m of t under (ern f ρm) As ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f a));
      intros; cbn [drn drn_ne drn_nf dmrn dern List.map extend_env fst snd] in *;
      repeat change (List.map (dern f) ?ρ) with (ern f ρ) in *;
      autorewrite with rn in *; cbn [List.map] in *;
      try solve [ econstructor; autorewrite with rn; eauto ].
    all: try solve [ econstructor; [ eassumption | rewrite elim_grp_of_rn; eassumption | eassumption ] ].
    all: try solve [ econstructor; [ eassumption | eassumption | rewrite elim_grp_of_rn; eassumption | eassumption ] ].
    all: try solve [ econstructor; [ apply kind_rn; eassumption | eassumption | eauto | eauto ] ].
    - (* a variable *) rewrite <- env_var_rn; apply eval_exp_var.
    - (* a module slot *) rewrite <- env_mod_rn; apply eval_me_var.
  Qed.
End Eval.

Values that Mention Only the Levels Below b

dav v b d of Core.Semantic.Avoid bounds the levels of d by b and excludes v; at every v ≥ b the exclusion is vacuous, and a closure evaluated at a level ≥ b stays within the bound.
Definition dbd (b : nat) (d : domain) : Prop := forall v, b <= v -> dav v b d.
Definition dbd_ne (b : nat) (m : domain_ne) : Prop := forall v, b <= v -> dav_ne v b m.
Definition dbd_nf (b : nat) (n : domain_nf) : Prop := forall v, b <= v -> dav_nf v b n.
Definition dbd_la (b : nat) (xs : list (nat * nat * domain_ne)) : Prop := forall v, b <= v -> dav_la v b xs.

Section Bound.
  Variables (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack).

  Ltac dbd_inv := unfold dbd, dbd_ne, dbd_nf, dbd_la in *; intros * H; repeat split; intros v Hv;
    repeat match goal with H : forall v, _ <= v -> _ |- _ => specialize (H v ltac:(lia)) end;
    repeat match goal with
      | H : dav _ _ (_ _) |- _ => inversion_clear H
      | H : dav _ _ (_ _ _) |- _ => inversion_clear H
      | H : dav _ _ (_ _ _ _) |- _ => inversion_clear H
      | H : dav_ne _ _ (_ _) |- _ => inversion_clear H
      | H : dav_ne _ _ (_ _ _) |- _ => inversion_clear H
      | H : dav_ne _ _ (_ _ _ _ _) |- _ => inversion_clear H
      | H : dav_nf _ _ (_ _ _) |- _ => inversion_clear H
      | H : dav_la _ _ (_ :: _) |- _ => inversion_clear H
      end;
    try lia; try assumption.

  Lemma dbd_nf_inv : forall b a m, dbd_nf b (⇓ a m) -> dbd b a /\ dbd b m.
  Proof. dbd_inv. Qed.
  Lemma dbd_neut_inv : forall b a m, dbd b (⇑ a m) -> dbd b a /\ dbd_ne b m.
  Proof. dbd_inv. Qed.
  Lemma dbd_suniv_inv : forall b l, dbd b 𝕌@l -> dbd b l.
  Proof. dbd_inv. Qed.
  Lemma dbd_lvl_inv : forall b c xs, dbd b (lvᵈ c xs) -> dbd_la b xs.
  Proof. dbd_inv. Qed.
  Lemma dbd_la_inv : forall b k n m xs, dbd_la b ((k, n, m) :: xs) -> dbd_ne b m /\ dbd_la b xs.
  Proof. dbd_inv. Qed.
  Lemma dbd_app_inv : forall b m n, dbd_ne b (m $ᵈ n) -> dbd_ne b m /\ dbd_nf b n.
  Proof. dbd_inv. Qed.
  Lemma dbd_var_inv : forall b x, dbd_ne b (#ᵈ x) -> x < b.
  Proof. intros * H; specialize (H b (le_n _)); inversion H; assumption. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_mono : forall b b' d, b <= b' -> dbd b d -> dbd b' d.
  Proof. intros * Hb H v Hv; eapply dav_mono'; [| apply H ]; lia. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_fresh : forall b s a, s < b -> dbd s a -> dbd b (⇑! a s).
  Proof.
    intros * Hs Ha v Hv; constructor; [ eapply dav_mono'; [| apply Ha ]; lia | constructor; lia ].
  Qed.

  Lemma dbd_bot : forall b, dbd b ⊥ᵈ.
  Proof. intros b v Hv; constructor. Qed.
  Lemma dbd_level : forall b n, dbd b (Levelᵈ@n).
  Proof. intros b v Hv; constructor. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_nf_dom : forall b a m, dbd b a -> dbd b m -> dbd_nf b (⇓ a m).
  Proof. intros * Ha Hm v Hv; constructor; auto. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_app : forall b m n r, $| m & n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> dbd b m -> dbd b n -> dbd b r.
  Proof. intros * Hr Hm Hn v Hv; eapply app_av; eauto. Qed.

A closure of a bounded value, evaluated at bounded arguments, at any larger bound.
  Definition dbd_clo (b : nat) (ρ : env) (B : exp) : Prop :=
    forall b' c d, b <= b' -> dbd b' c -> ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↦ c ↘ d -> dbd b' d.
  Definition dbd_clo2 (b : nat) (ρ : env) (B : exp) : Prop :=
    forall b' c1 c2 d, b <= b' -> dbd b' c1 -> dbd b' c2 -> ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↦ c1 ↦ c2 ↘ d -> dbd b' d.

  Lemma dbd_pi_inv : forall b a ρ B, dbd b (Πᵈ a ρ B) -> dbd b a /\ dbd_clo b ρ B.
  Proof.
    intros * H; split; [ intros v Hv; specialize (H v Hv); inversion H; assumption |].
    intros b' c d Hb Hc Hd v Hv.
    specialize (H v ltac:(lia)); inversion_clear H.
    eapply eval_clo_av; [ eapply env_av_mono; [| eassumption ]; lia | eassumption | apply Hc; lia | exact Hd ].
  Qed.

  Lemma dbd_exfalso_inv : forall b ρ A m,
      dbd_ne b (efqᵈ m under ρ return A) -> dbd_ne b m /\ dbd_clo b ρ A.
  Proof.
    intros * H; split; [ intros v Hv; specialize (H v Hv); inversion H; assumption |].
    intros b' c d Hb Hc Hd v Hv.
    specialize (H v ltac:(lia)); inversion_clear H.
    eapply eval_clo_av; [ eapply env_av_mono; [| eassumption ]; lia | eassumption | apply Hc; lia | exact Hd ].
  Qed.

Inductive Types

An environment of bounded values, and a closure under n binders.
  Definition env_dbd (b : nat) (ρ : env) : Prop := forall v, b <= v -> env_av v b None ρ.

  Definition dbd_clon (b : nat) (ρ : env) (B : exp) (n : nat) : Prop :=
    forall b' cs d, b <= b' -> List.length cs = n -> (forall c, In c cs -> dbd b' c) ->
               ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ env_args ρ cs ↘ d -> dbd b' d.

A closure under n binders whose environment avoids the excluded level at every position its body reads, as the invariant states it.
  Definition dbd_eclo (b : nat) (ρ : env) (B : exp) (n : nat) : Prop :=
    forall v, b <= v -> exists K, env_av v b K ρ /\ ofresh (oshift n K) B.

  Lemma dbd_eclo_clon : forall b ρ B n, dbd_eclo b ρ B n -> dbd_clon b ρ B n.
  Proof.
    intros * H b' cs d Hb Hl Hc Hd v Hv; destruct (H v ltac:(lia)) as (K & HK & HB).
    eapply (proj1 (eval_av Θ Ξ v b'));
      [ exact Hd | apply env_av_args; [ eapply env_av_mono; [| exact HK ]; lia | intros; apply Hc; [ assumption | lia ] ] |].
    rewrite Hl; exact HB.
  Qed.

  Lemma env_dbd_nil : forall b, env_dbd b nil.
  Proof. intros b v _; apply env_av_nil. Qed.

  Lemma env_dbd_args : forall b ρ args, env_dbd b ρ -> (forall a, In a args -> dbd b a) -> env_dbd b (env_args ρ args).
  Proof. intros * Hρ Ha v Hv; apply env_av_args_none; [ apply Hρ, Hv | intros; apply Ha; assumption ]. Qed.

  Lemma env_dbd_cons : forall b ρ d, env_dbd b ρ -> dbd b d -> env_dbd b (ρ ↦ d).
  Proof. intros * Hρ Hd v Hv; apply env_av_cons_none; [ apply Hρ, Hv | apply Hd, Hv ]. Qed.

  Lemma env_dbd_mono : forall b b' ρ, b <= b' -> env_dbd b ρ -> env_dbd b' ρ.
  Proof. intros * Hb Hρ v Hv; eapply env_av_mono; [| apply Hρ ]; lia. Qed.

  Lemma eval_dbd : forall M ρ a b, ⟦ M ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ a -> env_dbd b ρ -> dbd b a.
  Proof. intros * H Hρ v Hv; eapply (proj1 (eval_av Θ Ξ v b)); [ exact H | apply Hρ, Hv | exact I ]. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_indty : forall b p k args, (forall a, In a args -> dbd b a) -> dbd b (d_ind p k args).
  Proof. intros * Ha v Hv; constructor; intros; apply Ha; assumption. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_con : forall b p k c args, (forall a, In a args -> dbd b a) -> dbd b (d_con p k c args).
  Proof. intros * Ha v Hv; constructor; intros; apply Ha; assumption. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_indty_inv : forall b p k args, dbd b (d_ind p k args) -> forall a, In a args -> dbd b a.
  Proof. intros * H a Ha v Hv; specialize (H v Hv); inversion H; auto. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_con_inv : forall b p k c args, dbd b (d_con p k c args) -> forall a, In a args -> dbd b a.
  Proof. intros * H a Ha v Hv; specialize (H v Hv); inversion H; auto. Qed.

The blocks of an eliminator, closures in an environment that avoids the excluded level at every position they read.
  Definition dbd_blocks (b : nat) (ρ : env) (Bks : list eblock) : Prop :=
    forall v, b <= v -> exists K, env_av v b K ρ /\ blocks_ofresh K Bks.

  Lemma dbd_blocks_motive : forall b ρ Bks bk, dbd_blocks b ρ Bks -> In bk Bks -> dbd_eclo b ρ (eb_motive bk) (eb_nm bk).
  Proof.
    intros * H Hin v Hv; destruct (H v Hv) as (K & HK & HB); exists K; split; [ exact HK | exact (proj1 (HB _ Hin)) ].
  Qed.

  Lemma dbd_blocks_branch : forall b ρ Bks bk, dbd_blocks b ρ Bks -> In bk Bks ->
      forall c n B, In (c, n, B) (eb_brs bk) -> dbd_clon b ρ B n.
  Proof.
    intros * H Hin c n B HB b' cs d Hb Hl Hc Hd v Hv; destruct (H v ltac:(lia)) as (K & HK & HBk).
    eapply (proj1 (eval_av Θ Ξ v b')); [ exact Hd | apply env_av_args; [ eapply env_av_mono; [| exact HK ]; lia | intros; apply Hc; [ assumption | lia ] ] |].
    rewrite Hl; exact (proj2 (HBk _ Hin) _ _ _ HB).
  Qed.

  Lemma dbd_blocks_mono : forall b b' ρ Bks, b <= b' -> dbd_blocks b ρ Bks -> dbd_blocks b' ρ Bks.
  Proof.
    intros * Hb H v Hv; destruct (H v ltac:(lia)) as (K & HK & HB); exists K; split; [ eapply env_av_mono; [| exact HK ]; lia | exact HB ].
  Qed.

  Lemma mref_dbd : forall p ups j r b, ⟦mref j of p ups ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r ->
      (forall u, In u ups -> dbd b u) -> forall a, In a (snd r) -> dbd b a.
  Proof. intros * H Hu a Ha v Hv; eapply mref_av; [ exact H | intros; apply Hu; assumption | exact Ha ]. Qed.

  Lemma dbd_elim_inv : forall b ρ Bks p ups j args m,
      dbd_ne b (d_elim ρ Bks p ups j args m) ->
      dbd_ne b m /\ (forall a, In a args -> dbd b a) /\ dbd_blocks b ρ Bks /\
      (forall a, In a ups -> dbd b a).
  Proof.
    intros * H; repeat split.
    - intros v Hv; specialize (H v Hv); inversion H; assumption.
    - intros a Ha v Hv; specialize (H v Hv); inversion H; auto.
    - intros v Hv; specialize (H v Hv); inversion_clear H; eexists; split; eassumption.
    - intros a Ha v Hv; specialize (H v Hv); inversion_clear H; eauto.
  Qed.

The uniform parameters an eliminator carries, bounded.
  Definition ups_dbd (b : nat) (ups : list domain) : Prop := forall a, In a ups -> dbd b a.

  Lemma ups_dbd_av : forall b ups, ups_dbd b ups -> forall v, b <= v -> ups_av v b ups.
  Proof. intros * H v Hv a Ha; exact (H a Ha v Hv). Qed.

  Lemma ups_dbd_mono : forall b b' ups, b <= b' -> ups_dbd b ups -> ups_dbd b' ups.
  Proof. intros * Hb H a Ha; exact (dbd_mono _ _ _ Hb (H a Ha)). Qed.

The fresh variables of the telescopes of a declaration are above the readback length, and below the length past them.
  Lemma fresh_tele_dbd : forall ρ T s ns, Ftele T in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ ns -> env_dbd s ρ ->
      forall a, In a ns -> dbd (s + List.length T) a.
  Proof.
    induction 1; intros Hρ; [ intros ? [] |].
    assert (Ha : dbd s a) by (eapply eval_dbd; eassumption).
    cbn [List.length]; replace (s + S (List.length T)) with (S s + List.length T) by lia.
    intros d [<- | Hd].
    - apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | exact Ha ].
    - apply IHfresh_tele; [| exact Hd ]. apply env_dbd_cons; [ eapply env_dbd_mono; [| exact Hρ ]; lia | apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | exact Ha ] ].
  Qed.

  Lemma shty_dbd : forall p ups ρ t a b, ⟦shty t of p ups ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ a ->
      env_dbd b ρ -> (forall u, In u ups -> dbd b u) -> dbd b a.
  Proof.
    intros * H Hρ Hu v Hv; eapply shty_av; [ exact H | apply Hρ, Hv | apply ptfresh_none | intros; apply Hu; assumption ].
  Qed.

  Lemma fresh_cargs_dbd : forall p ups ρ gs s vs, Fcargs gs of p ups in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ vs ->
      env_dbd s ρ -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) ->
      forall a, In a vs -> dbd (s + List.length gs) a.
  Proof.
    induction 1; intros Hρ Hu.
    - intros ? [].
    - assert (Ha : dbd s a) by (eapply eval_dbd; eassumption).
      cbn [List.length]; replace (s + S (List.length gs)) with (S s + List.length gs) by lia.
      intros d [<- | Hd]; [ apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | exact Ha ] |].
      apply IHfresh_cargs;
        [ apply env_dbd_cons; [ eapply env_dbd_mono; [| exact Hρ ]; lia | apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | exact Ha ] ]
        | intros; eapply dbd_mono; [| apply Hu; eassumption ]; lia | exact Hd ].
    - assert (Ha : dbd s a) by (eapply shty_dbd; eassumption).
      cbn [List.length]; replace (s + S (List.length gs)) with (S s + List.length gs) by lia.
      intros d [<- | Hd]; [ apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | exact Ha ] |].
      apply IHfresh_cargs;
        [ eapply env_dbd_mono; [| exact Hρ ]; lia | intros; eapply dbd_mono; [| apply Hu; eassumption ]; lia | exact Hd ].
  Qed.

  Lemma fresh_ihs_dbd : forall ρ As ρa gs' gs vs s ihs, Fihs vs at gs' gs under ρ As in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρa ⍮ s ↘ ihs ->
      forall b, b <= s -> env_dbd s ρa ->
      Forall (fun g => match g with
                       | ca_rec t => dbd_eclo b ρ (List.nth (ptyp_mem t) As a_True) (S (List.length (ptyp_ps t)))
                       | ca_arg _ => True end) gs ->
      (forall a, In a vs -> dbd s a) ->
      forall a, In a ihs -> dbd (s + cargs_nrec gs') a.
  Proof.
    induction 1; intros b0 Hb Hρa Hl Hvs.
    - intros ? [].
    - inversion_clear Hl as [| ? ? _ Hl2].
      apply (IHfresh_ihs b0); auto.
      + apply env_dbd_cons; [ exact Hρa | apply Hvs; left; reflexivity ].
      + intros; apply Hvs; right; assumption.
    - inversion_clear Hl as [| ? ? Hl1 Hl2]; cbn beta iota in Hl1.
      assert (Ha : dbd s a).
      { intros w Hw; destruct (Hl1 w ltac:(lia)) as (K & HK & HfA).
        eapply ihty_av; [ exact H | eapply env_av_mono; [| exact HK ]; lia | exact HfA
                        | apply Hρa, Hw | apply ptfresh_none | apply Hvs; [ left; reflexivity | exact Hw ] ]. }
      cbn [cargs_nrec]; replace (s + S (cargs_nrec gs')) with (S s + cargs_nrec gs') by lia.
      intros d [<- | Hd].
      + apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | exact Ha ].
      + eapply (IHfresh_ihs b0); try eassumption; try lia.
        * eapply env_dbd_mono; [| exact Hρa ]; lia.
        * intros; eapply dbd_mono; [| apply Hvs; right; eassumption ]; lia.
    - inversion_clear Hl as [| ? ? _ Hl2].
      cbn [cargs_nrec]; apply (IHfresh_ihs b0); auto.
      intros; apply Hvs; right; assumption.
  Qed.

The motives at the recursive arguments of the eliminator's group, from the blocks.
  Lemma ihs_motives_dbd : forall D Bks b ρ gs, cargs_plen D gs -> blocks_nm_at D None Bks -> dbd_blocks b ρ Bks ->
      Forall (fun g => match g with
                       | ca_rec t => dbd_eclo b ρ (List.nth (ptyp_mem t) (blocks_motives Bks) a_True)
                                       (S (List.length (ptyp_ps t)))
                       | ca_arg _ => True end) gs.
  Proof.
    intros * Hpl Hnm HB.
    pose proof (plen_forall _ _ Hpl) as Hf.
    eapply Forall_impl; [| exact Hf ]; intros [A | t] H; [ exact I |].
    destruct H as (Mj & HMj & Hl).
    intros v Hv; destruct (HB v Hv) as (K & HK & HBk); exists K; split; [ exact HK |].
    pose proof (nth_motives_sel None Bks (ptyp_mem t)) as Hm; cbn [motives_sel elim_src] in Hm.
    destruct Hm as [-> | (bk & Hbk & ->)]; [ destruct K; exact I |].
    rewrite Hl, <- (Hnm _ _ _ HMj Hbk); exact (proj1 (HBk _ (List.nth_error_In _ _ Hbk))).
  Qed.

The recursive results a branch is read under.
  Lemma wrap_ihs_eval_dbd : forall ρ p ups Bks gs' gs vs ihs r b,
      ⟦wihs vs of gs' gs with ihs under p ups Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ r ->
      dbd_blocks b ρ Bks -> ups_dbd b ups -> (forall a, In a vs -> dbd b a) -> (forall a, In a ihs -> dbd b a) ->
      forall a, In a r -> dbd b a.
  Proof.
    intros * H HB Ho Hv Hi a Ha w Hw; destruct (HB w Hw) as (K & HK & HBk).
    eapply wrap_ihs_eval_av; [ exact H | exact HK | exact HBk | exact (ups_dbd_av _ _ Ho _ Hw)
                             | intros; apply Hv; assumption | intros; apply Hi; assumption | exact Ha ].
  Qed.
End Bound.

The bound of a value built during readback: by its constructor, by monotonicity, or by the evaluation it came from.
Ltac dbd_solve :=
  first [ eassumption
        | apply dbd_nf_dom; dbd_solve
        | apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | dbd_solve ]
        | apply dbd_bot | apply dbd_level
        | match goal with
          | Hc : dbd_clo _ _ ?b ?ρ ?B, e : ⟦ ?B ⟧ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?ρ ↦ ?c ↘ ?d |- dbd ?b' ?d =>
              apply (Hc b' c d); [ lia | dbd_solve | exact e ]
          | Hc : dbd_clo2 _ _ ?b ?ρ ?B, e : ⟦ ?B ⟧ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?ρ ↦ ?c1 ↦ ?c2 ↘ ?d |- dbd ?b' ?d =>
              apply (Hc b' c1 c2 d); [ lia | dbd_solve | dbd_solve | exact e ]
          | e : $| ?m & ?n | ?T ⍮ ?X ↘ ?r |- dbd ?b ?r => apply (dbd_app T X b m n r e); dbd_solve
          | H : dbd ?b0 ?d |- dbd ?b ?d => apply (dbd_mono b0 b d); [ lia | exact H ]
          end ].

Readback Is Equivariant

rn_ok f s s' φ: reading back at s and at s', the renaming f of levels and the weakening φ of indices agree on the levels below s; from s on, f is the shift by s' - s, so the fresh levels of the two readbacks correspond.
Record rn_ok (f : nat -> nat) (s s' : nat) (φ : wk) : Prop := mk_rn_ok
  { rn_le : s <= s'
  ; rn_above : forall x, s <= x -> f x = x + (s' - s)
  ; rn_below : forall x, x < s -> f x < s'
  ; rn_index : forall x, x < s -> φ (s - x - 1) = s' - f x - 1
  ; rn_mono : wk_mono φ }.

Lemma rn_ok_fresh : forall f s s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> f s = s'.
Proof. intros * [? Hf _ _ _]; rewrite Hf; lia. Qed.

Lemma rn_ok_q : forall f s s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> rn_ok f (S s) (S s') (wk_q φ).
Proof.
  intros * [Hs Hf Hlt Hφ Hm]; constructor.
  - lia.
  - intros x Hx; rewrite (Hf x); lia.
  - intros x Hx; destruct (Nat.eq_dec x s) as [-> |]; [ rewrite (Hf s); lia | specialize (Hlt x ltac:(lia)); lia ].
  - intros x Hx; destruct (Nat.eq_dec x s) as [-> |].
    + rewrite (Hf s) by lia; replace (S s - s - 1) with 0 by lia; cbn [wk_q]; lia.
    + replace (S s - x - 1) with (S (s - x - 1)) by lia; cbn [wk_q].
      rewrite Hφ by lia; specialize (Hlt x ltac:(lia)); lia.
  - apply wk_mono_q, Hm.
Qed.

Lemma rn_ok_qn : forall n f s s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> rn_ok f (n + s) (n + s') (wk_qn n φ).
Proof. induction n; intros * H; cbn; [ exact H | apply rn_ok_q; auto ]. Qed.

Lemma nfs_wk_app : forall φ Ms Ns, nfs_wk φ (nfs_app Ms Ns) = nfs_app (nfs_wk φ Ms) (nfs_wk φ Ns).
Proof. induction Ms; intros; cbn; congruence. Qed.

Section Read.
  Variables (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (f : nat -> nat).

  Lemma eval_clo_rn : forall B ρ c d,
      ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↦ c ↘ d -> ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↦ drn f c ↘ drn f d.
  Proof. intros * H; exact (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ H). Qed.

  Lemma eval_clo2_rn : forall B ρ c1 c2 d,
      ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↦ c1 ↦ c2 ↘ d -> ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↦ drn f c1 ↦ drn f c2 ↘ drn f d.
  Proof. intros * H; exact (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ H). Qed.

  Lemma app_rn : forall m n r, $| m & n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ r -> $| drn f m & drn f n | Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ drn f r.
  Proof. intros * H; exact (proj1 (proj2 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f)) _ _ _ H). Qed.

  Lemma eval_args_rn : forall B ρ args d,
      ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ env_args ρ args ↘ d -> ⟦ B ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ env_args (ern f ρ) (List.map (drn f) args) ↘ drn f d.
  Proof. intros * H; rewrite <- env_args_rn; exact (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ H). Qed.

The fresh variables of the telescopes of a declaration, renamed: from the readback length on, f is the shift to the other length.
  Lemma fresh_tele_rn : forall ρ T s ns, Ftele T in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ ns ->
      forall s', (forall x, s <= x -> f x = x + (s' - s)) -> s <= s' ->
      Ftele T in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ List.map (drn f) ns.
  Proof.
    induction 1; intros s' Hf Hs; cbn [List.map]; [ constructor |].
    cbn [drn drn_ne]; rewrite (Hf s) by lia; replace (s + (s' - s)) with s' by lia.
    constructor; [ exact (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ H) |].
    pose proof (IHfresh_tele (S s') ltac:(intros; rewrite Hf by lia; lia) ltac:(lia)) as IH.
    cbn [ern List.map dern drn drn_ne extend_env] in IH; rewrite (Hf s) in IH by lia.
    replace (s + (s' - s)) with s' in IH by lia; exact IH.
  Qed.

  Lemma shty_rn : forall p ups ρ t a,
      ⟦shty t of p ups ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ a -> ⟦shty t of p (List.map (drn f) ups) ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f a.
  Proof.
    intros * H; destruct (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) as (_ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & Hs & _).
    exact (Hs _ _ _ _ _ H).
  Qed.

  Lemma ihty_rn : forall ρm As ρ t m a,
      ⟦ihty m of t under ρm As ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ a -> ⟦ihty drn f m of t under (ern f ρm) As ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f a.
  Proof.
    intros * H; destruct (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) as (_ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & Hy).
    exact (Hy _ _ _ _ _ _ H).
  Qed.

  Lemma ih_rn : forall ρ p ups Bks t m r,
      ⟦ih m of t under p ups Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ r -> ⟦ih drn f m of t under p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ↘ drn f r.
  Proof.
    intros * H; destruct (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) as (_ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & Hi & _).
    exact (Hi _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H).
  Qed.

  Lemma mref_rn : forall p ups j hd k pre,
      ⟦mref j of p ups ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ (hd, k, pre) -> ⟦mref j of p (List.map (drn f) ups) ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ↘ (hd, k, List.map (drn f) pre).
  Proof.
    intros * H; destruct (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) as (_ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & Hm & _).
    exact (Hm _ _ _ _ H).
  Qed.

  Lemma wrap_ihs_eval_rn : forall ρ p ups Bks gs' gs vs ihs r,
      ⟦wihs vs of gs' gs with ihs under p ups Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ r ->
      ⟦wihs (List.map (drn f) vs) of gs' gs with (List.map (drn f) ihs) under p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ
        ↘ List.map (drn f) r.
  Proof. induction 1; cbn [List.map]; econstructor; eauto using ih_rn. Qed.

  Lemma fresh_cargs_rn : forall p ups ρ gs s vs, Fcargs gs of p ups in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ vs ->
      forall s', (forall x, s <= x -> f x = x + (s' - s)) -> s <= s' ->
      Fcargs gs of p (List.map (drn f) ups) in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ List.map (drn f) vs.
  Proof.
    induction 1; intros s' Hf Hs; cbn [List.map]; [ constructor | |].
    - cbn [drn drn_ne]; rewrite (Hf s) by lia; replace (s + (s' - s)) with s' by lia.
      constructor; [ exact (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ H) |].
      pose proof (IHfresh_cargs (S s') ltac:(intros; rewrite Hf by lia; lia) ltac:(lia)) as IH.
      cbn [ern List.map dern drn drn_ne extend_env] in IH; rewrite (Hf s) in IH by lia.
      replace (s + (s' - s)) with s' in IH by lia; exact IH.
    - cbn [drn drn_ne]; rewrite (Hf s) by lia; replace (s + (s' - s)) with s' by lia.
      constructor; [ exact (shty_rn _ _ _ _ _ H) |].
      apply (IHfresh_cargs (S s')); [ intros; rewrite Hf by lia; lia | lia ].
  Qed.

  Lemma fresh_ihs_rn : forall ρ As ρa gs' gs vs s ihs, Fihs vs at gs' gs under ρ As in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρa ⍮ s ↘ ihs ->
      forall s', (forall x, s <= x -> f x = x + (s' - s)) -> s <= s' ->
      Fihs List.map (drn f) vs at gs' gs under (ern f ρ) As in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρa ⍮ s' ↘ List.map (drn f) ihs.
  Proof.
    induction 1; intros s' Hf Hs; cbn [List.map]; [ constructor | | |].
    - constructor; pose proof (IHfresh_ihs s' Hf Hs) as IH.
      cbn [ern List.map dern extend_env] in IH |- *; exact IH.
    - cbn [drn drn_ne]; rewrite (Hf s) by lia; replace (s + (s' - s)) with s' by lia.
      constructor; [ exact (ihty_rn _ _ _ _ _ _ H) |].
      apply (IHfresh_ihs (S s')); [ intros; rewrite Hf by lia; lia | lia ].
    - apply fresh_ihs_nest; exact (IHfresh_ihs s' Hf Hs).
  Qed.

  Lemma read_rn :
    (forall s m W, Rnf m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s ↘ W ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_nf s m -> Rnf drn_nf f m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ nf_wk φ W) /\
    (forall s m M, Rne m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s ↘ M ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_ne s m -> Rne drn_ne f m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ ne_wk φ M) /\
    (forall s a A, Rtyp a in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s ↘ A ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd s a -> Rtyp drn f a in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ nf_wk φ A) /\
    (forall s xs ys, Rla xs in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s ↘ ys ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_la s xs -> Rla larn f xs in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ la_wk φ ys) /\
    (forall s ρ T vs Ms, Rps vs at T in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ Ms ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> env_dbd s ρ -> (forall a, In a vs -> dbd s a) ->
       Rps List.map (drn f) vs at T in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nfs_wk φ Ms) /\
    (forall s p ups ρ gs vs Ms, Rcargs vs at gs of p ups in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ Ms ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) -> env_dbd s ρ ->
       (forall a, In a vs -> dbd s a) ->
       Rcargs List.map (drn f) vs at gs of p (List.map (drn f) ups) in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nfs_wk φ Ms) /\
    (forall s p ups ρ t x X, Rsh x at t of p ups in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ X ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) -> env_dbd s ρ -> dbd s x ->
       Rsh drn f x at t of p (List.map (drn f) ups) in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nf_wk φ X) /\
    (forall s ρ p ups Bks sel i Ms NBks, Rblks i Ms from p ups Bks sel in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ NBks ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_blocks s ρ Bks ->
       (forall D, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> blocks_nm_at D None Bks) -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) ->
       Rblks i Ms from p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks sel in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nblocks_wk φ NBks) /\
    (forall s ρ p ups Bks Mv A Mi r cs Bs Bs', Rbrs Bs at cs of Mi r from p ups Bks Mv A in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ Bs' ->
       forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_blocks s ρ Bks ->
       (forall D, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> blocks_nm_at D None Bks) -> im_nn Mv = im_nn Mi ->
       dbd_eclo s ρ A (S (im_nn Mi)) ->
       (forall c n B, In (c, n, B) Bs -> dbd_clon Θ Ξ s ρ B n) -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) ->
       (forall a, In a (snd r) -> dbd s a) ->
       Rbrs Bs at cs of Mi (fst (fst r), snd (fst r), List.map (drn f) (snd r)) from p (List.map (drn f) ups)
         Bks Mv A in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nbrs_wk φ Bs').
  Proof.
    apply (read_mut_ind Θ Ξ
             (fun s m W _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_nf s m -> Rnf drn_nf f m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ nf_wk φ W)
             (fun s m M _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_ne s m -> Rne drn_ne f m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ ne_wk φ M)
             (fun s a A _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd s a -> Rtyp drn f a in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ nf_wk φ A)
             (fun s xs ys _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_la s xs -> Rla larn f xs in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ la_wk φ ys)
             (fun s ρ T vs Ms _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> env_dbd s ρ -> (forall a, In a vs -> dbd s a) ->
                Rps List.map (drn f) vs at T in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nfs_wk φ Ms)
             (fun s p ups ρ gs vs Ms _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) ->
                env_dbd s ρ -> (forall a, In a vs -> dbd s a) ->
                Rcargs List.map (drn f) vs at gs of p (List.map (drn f) ups) in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nfs_wk φ Ms)
             (fun s p ups ρ t x X _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) ->
                env_dbd s ρ -> dbd s x ->
                Rsh drn f x at t of p (List.map (drn f) ups) in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nf_wk φ X)
             (fun s ρ p ups Bks sel i Ms NBks _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_blocks s ρ Bks ->
                (forall D, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> blocks_nm_at D None Bks) -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) ->
                Rblks i Ms from p (List.map (drn f) ups) Bks sel in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nblocks_wk φ NBks)
             (fun s ρ p ups Bks Mv A Mi r cs Bs Bs' _ => forall s' φ, rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_blocks s ρ Bks ->
                (forall D, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> blocks_nm_at D None Bks) -> im_nn Mv = im_nn Mi ->
                dbd_eclo s ρ A (S (im_nn Mi)) ->
                (forall c n B, In (c, n, B) Bs -> dbd_clon Θ Ξ s ρ B n) -> (forall a, In a ups -> dbd s a) ->
                (forall a, In a (snd r) -> dbd s a) ->
                Rbrs Bs at cs of Mi (fst (fst r), snd (fst r), List.map (drn f) (snd r)) from p (List.map (drn f) ups)
                  Bks Mv A in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ern f ρ ⍮ s' ↘ nbrs_wk φ Bs'));
      intros; cbn [drn drn_ne drn_nf dmrn dern nf_wk ne_wk la_wk larn nfs_wk nbrs_wk nblocks_wk List.map fst snd] in *.
The bounds of the parts.
    all: repeat match goal with
      | H : dbd_nf _ (d_dom _ _) |- _ => apply dbd_nf_inv in H as [? ?]
      | H : dbd _ (d_neut _ _) |- _ => apply dbd_neut_inv in H as [? ?]
      | H : dbd _ (d_suniv _) |- _ => apply dbd_suniv_inv in H
      | H : dbd _ (d_lvl _ _) |- _ => apply dbd_lvl_inv in H
      | H : dbd _ (d_pi _ _ _) |- _ => apply (dbd_pi_inv Θ Ξ) in H as [? ?]
      | H : dbd_la _ ((_, _) :: _) |- _ => apply dbd_la_inv in H as [? ?]
      | H : dbd_ne _ (d_app _ _) |- _ => apply dbd_app_inv in H as [? ?]
      | H : dbd_ne _ (d_exfalso _ _ _) |- _ => apply (dbd_exfalso_inv Θ Ξ) in H as [? ?]
      | H : dbd _ (d_ind _ _ _) |- _ => pose proof (dbd_indty_inv _ _ _ _ H); clear H
      | H : dbd _ (d_con _ _ _ _) |- _ => pose proof (dbd_con_inv _ _ _ _ _ H); clear H
      | H : dbd_ne _ (d_elim _ _ _ _ _ _ _) |- _ => apply dbd_elim_inv in H as (? & ? & ? & ?)
      end.
The fresh levels correspond, under one binder and under two.
    all: match goal with Hok : rn_ok f ?s ?s' ?φ |- _ =>
           pose proof (rn_ok_fresh _ _ _ _ Hok) as Hf0;
           pose proof (rn_ok_fresh _ _ _ _ (rn_ok_q _ _ _ _ Hok)) as Hf1;
           pose proof (rn_ok_q _ _ _ _ Hok) as Hok1; pose proof (rn_ok_q _ _ _ _ Hok1) as Hok2
         end.
The evaluations of the renamed closures.
    all: on_all_hyp: fun H => match type of H with
      | ⟦ _ ⟧ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ↦ _ ↦ _ ↘ _ =>
          let H' := fresh "Er" in pose proof (eval_clo2_rn _ _ _ _ _ H) as H'; cbn [drn drn_ne] in H'
      | ⟦ _ ⟧ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ↦ _ ↘ _ =>
          let H' := fresh "Er" in pose proof (eval_clo_rn _ _ _ _ H) as H'; cbn [drn drn_ne] in H'
      | $| _ & _ | _ ⍮ _ ↘ _ =>
          let H' := fresh "Er" in pose proof (app_rn _ _ _ H) as H'; cbn [drn drn_ne] in H'
      | _ => idtac
      end.
    all: rewrite ?Hf0, ?Hf1 in *.
    all: repeat change (List.map (dern f) ?ρ) with (ern f ρ).
    all: cbn [larn] in *.
A level: the renaming commutes with its canonical form.
    all: try match goal with
         | Hok : rn_ok f _ _ ?φ |- read_nf _ _ _ _ (nf_wk _ (nf_lvl_of (lvl_canon _))) =>
             rewrite nf_lvl_of_wk, <- lvl_canon_wk by exact (rn_mono _ _ _ _ Hok);
             unfold lvl_wk; cbn [fst snd]
         end.
A variable: the index of x at s is renamed to that of f x at s'.
    all: try match goal with
         | Hok : rn_ok f ?s _ _, Hx : dbd_ne _ (d_var ?x) |- read_ne _ _ _ (d_var _) _ =>
             let Hφ := fresh "Hφ" in
             pose proof (rn_index _ _ _ _ Hok) as Hφ; rewrite Hφ by (eapply dbd_var_inv; exact Hx)
         end.
A small universe: the same through nf_univ_of.
    all: try match goal with |- read_typ _ _ _ (d_suniv _) _ => rewrite nf_univ_of_wk end.
A neutral level: its sort is that of its type, which the renaming keeps.
    all: try match goal with |- context [dsort ?a] => rewrite <- (dsort_rn f a) end.
Inductive types. A constructor at its type: the parameters and the arguments, renamed, at their renamed types.
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_nf _ _ _ _ (nf_con _ _ _ _) =>
      match goal with
      | Hl : ind_lookup _ _ ?p = Some ?D, Hk : ind_member ?D ?k = Some ?Mk, Hh : im_head ?Mk = mh_decl _,
        Hc : ind_con ?Mk ?c = Some ?gs,
        Hla : List.length ?as' = im_np _ _, Hlv : List.length ?vs = _,
        IH1 : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> env_dbd ?s nil -> _ -> read_ps _ _ s0 _ _ _ _,
        IH2 : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> _ -> env_dbd ?s (env_args nil ?as') -> _ -> read_cargs _ _ s0 _ _ _ _ _ _,
        Hok : rn_ok f ?s ?s' ?φ, Has : forall a, In a ?as' -> dbd ?s a, Hvs : forall a, In a ?vs -> dbd ?s a |- _ =>
          rewrite nfs_wk_app;
          eapply read_nf_con; [ exact Hl | exact Hk | exact Hh | exact Hc | rewrite List.length_map; exact Hla
                              | rewrite List.length_map; exact Hlv | exact (IH1 s' φ Hok (env_dbd_nil _) Has) | ];
          rewrite List.firstn_map, List.skipn_map;
          change (env_args nil (List.map (drn f) as')) with (env_args (ern f nil) (List.map (drn f) as'));
          rewrite <- env_args_rn;
          apply IH2; [ exact Hok | all_in_with assumption | apply env_dbd_args; [ apply env_dbd_nil | exact Has ]
                     | all_in_with assumption ]
      end end ].
A constructor at a view: as at a declared member, the arguments after the container's parameters.
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_nf _ _ _ _ (nf_con _ _ _ _) =>
      match goal with
      | Hl : ind_lookup _ _ ?p = Some ?D, Hk : ind_member ?D ?j = Some ?Mj, Hh : im_head ?Mj = mh_view _ _ _ _,
        Hc : ind_con ?Mj ?c = Some ?gs,
        Hla : List.length ?as' = im_np _ _, Hlv : List.length ?vs = _,
        IH1 : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> env_dbd ?s nil -> _ -> read_ps _ _ s0 _ _ _ _,
        IH2 : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> _ -> env_dbd ?s (env_args nil ?as') -> _ -> read_cargs _ _ s0 _ _ _ _ _ _,
        Hok : rn_ok f ?s ?s' ?φ, Has : forall a, In a ?as' -> dbd ?s a, Hvs : forall a, In a ?vs -> dbd ?s a |- _ =>
          rewrite nfs_wk_app;
          eapply read_nf_con_view; [ exact Hl | exact Hk | exact Hh | exact Hc
                                   | rewrite List.length_map; exact Hla
                                   | rewrite List.length_map; exact Hlv | exact (IH1 s' φ Hok (env_dbd_nil _) Has) | ];
          rewrite List.firstn_map, List.skipn_map;
          change (env_args nil (List.map (drn f) as')) with (env_args (ern f nil) (List.map (drn f) as'));
          rewrite <- env_args_rn;
          apply IH2; [ exact Hok | all_in_with assumption | apply env_dbd_args; [ apply env_dbd_nil | exact Has ]
                     | all_in_with assumption ]
      end end ].
A stuck eliminator: the blocks of the group read, renamed, at the renamed uniform parameters.
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_ne _ _ _ (d_elim _ _ _ _ _ _ _) _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hl : ind_lookup _ _ ?p = Some ?D, Hj : ind_member ?D ?j = Some ?Mj, Hr : im_ref ?p ?j ?Mj = (?pc, ?k),
        Hl' : ind_lookup _ _ ?pc = Some ?Dq, Hk : ind_member ?Dq ?k = Some ?Mk, Hlen : List.length ?as' = im_np _ _,
        Hnm : blocks_nm_at ?D None ?Bks,
        Hm : eval_mref _ _ ?p ?ups ?j (?pc, ?k, ?pre),
        IHp : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> env_dbd ?s nil -> _ -> read_ps _ _ s0 _ _ _ _,
        IHb : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> dbd_blocks ?s ?ρ ?Bks -> _ -> _ -> read_blocks _ _ s0 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _,
        IHm : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> dbd_ne ?s ?m -> read_ne _ _ s0 _ _,
        Hok : rn_ok f ?s ?s' ?φ, HBd : dbd_blocks ?s ?ρ ?Bks, Hmd : dbd_ne ?s ?m,
        Hu : forall a, In a ?ups -> dbd ?s a |- _ =>
          eapply read_ne_elim; [ exact Hl | exact Hj | exact Hr | exact Hl' | exact Hk
                               | rewrite List.length_map; exact Hlen | exact Hnm
                               | exact (mref_rn _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm)
                               | exact (IHp s' φ Hok (env_dbd_nil _) (mref_dbd Θ Ξ _ _ _ _ _ Hm Hu))
                               | apply (IHb s' φ Hok HBd); [| exact Hu ]
                               | apply IHm; [ exact Hok | exact Hmd ] ];
          intros D0 HD0; rewrite Hl in HD0; injection HD0 as <-; exact Hnm
      end end ].
A block: the motive, renamed, read one binder further than its non-uniform parameters; the branches; the blocks after it.
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_blocks _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (_ :: _) _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hl : ind_lookup _ _ ?p = Some ?D, Hv : ind_member ?D (elim_src ?sel ?i) = Some ?Mv,
        Hb : List.nth_error ?Bks (elim_src ?sel ?i) = Some ?bk, Hnmb : eb_nm ?bk = S (im_nn ?Mi),
        Hm : eval_mref _ _ ?p ?X (elim_src ?sel ?i) (?hd, ?k, ?pre),
        f0 : fresh_tele _ _ (env_args nil ?X) _ ?s ?ns,
        e2 : ⟦ eb_motive ?bk ⟧ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ env_args ?ρ (?ns ++ _) ↘ ?a,
        IHA : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f (S (?s + im_nn ?Mi)) s0 φ0 -> dbd _ ?a -> read_typ _ _ s0 _ _,
        IHB : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> dbd_blocks ?s ?ρ ?Bks -> _ -> _ -> dbd_eclo ?s ?ρ (eb_motive ?bk) _ ->
              _ -> _ -> _ -> read_brs _ _ s0 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _,
        IHK : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> dbd_blocks ?s ?ρ ?Bks -> _ -> _ -> read_blocks _ _ s0 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _,
        Hok : rn_ok f ?s ?s' ?φ, HBd : dbd_blocks ?s ?ρ ?Bks,
        Hnm : forall D0, ind_lookup _ _ ?p = Some D0 -> _,
        HX : forall a, In a ?X -> dbd ?s a |- _ =>
          let Hss := fresh "Hss" in let Hfx := fresh "Hfx" in
          let Hlen := fresh "Hlen" in let Hns := fresh "Hns" in let Hp := fresh "Hp" in let Hfn := fresh "Hfn" in
          let Hin := fresh "Hin" in let Hnn := fresh "Hnn" in
          pose proof Hok as [Hss Hfx _ _ _];
          pose proof (List.nth_error_In _ _ Hb) as Hin;
          assert (Hnn : im_nn Mv = im_nn Mi) by (pose proof (Hnm _ Hl _ _ _ Hv Hb) as Hx; congruence);
          pose proof (fresh_tele_length _ _ _ _ f0) as Hlen; rewrite List.length_rev in Hlen;
          change (List.length (im_nparams Mv)) with (im_nn Mv) in Hlen; rewrite Hnn in Hlen;
          assert (Hns : forall x, In x ns -> dbd (s + im_nn Mi) x)
            by (let H' := fresh in
                pose proof (fresh_tele_dbd Θ Ξ _ _ _ _ f0 ltac:(apply env_dbd_args; [ apply env_dbd_nil | exact HX ])) as H';
                rewrite List.length_rev in H'; change (List.length (im_nparams Mv)) with (im_nn Mv) in H';
                rewrite Hnn in H'; exact H');
          pose proof (mref_dbd Θ Ξ _ _ _ _ _ Hm HX) as Hp; cbn [snd] in Hp;
          assert (Hfn : f (s + im_nn Mi) = s' + im_nn Mi) by (rewrite Hfx; lia);
          eapply read_blocks_cons;
          [ exact Hl | exact Hv | exact Hb | exact Hnmb | exact (mref_rn _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm)
          | let H' := fresh in pose proof (fresh_tele_rn _ _ _ _ f0 s' Hfx Hss) as H'; rewrite env_args_rn in H';
            cbn [ern List.map] in H'; exact H'
          | let H' := fresh in pose proof (eval_args_rn _ _ _ _ e2) as H'; rewrite List.map_app in H';
            cbn [List.map drn drn_ne] in H'; rewrite Hfn, List.map_app in H'; exact H'
          | replace (S (s' + im_nn Mi)) with (S (im_nn Mi) + s') by lia; apply IHA;
            [ replace (S (s + im_nn Mi)) with (S (im_nn Mi) + s) by lia; apply rn_ok_qn, Hok |];
            eapply (dbd_eclo_clon Θ Ξ _ _ _ _ (dbd_blocks_motive _ _ _ _ HBd Hin)); [ lia | | | exact e2 ];
              [ rewrite length_app, Hlen, Hnmb; cbn; lia |];
              apply all_in_app; [ intros; eapply dbd_mono; [| apply Hns; eassumption ]; lia |];
              apply all_in_cons; [| apply all_in_nil ];
              apply dbd_fresh; [ lia |]; apply dbd_indty; apply all_in_app;
                [ intros; eapply dbd_mono; [| apply Hp; eassumption ]; lia | exact Hns ]
          | apply IHB; [ exact Hok | exact HBd | exact Hnm | exact Hnn
                       | rewrite <- Hnmb; exact (dbd_blocks_motive _ _ _ _ HBd Hin)
                       | exact (dbd_blocks_branch Θ Ξ _ _ _ _ HBd Hin) | exact HX | exact Hp ]
          | apply IHK; [ exact Hok | exact HBd | exact Hnm | exact HX ] ]
      end end ].
An inductive type at its parameters.
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_typ _ _ _ (d_ind _ _ _) _ =>
      match goal with
      | IH : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> env_dbd ?s nil -> _ -> read_ps _ _ s0 _ _ _ _,
        Hok : rn_ok f ?s ?s' ?φ, Has : forall a, In a ?as' -> dbd ?s a |- _ =>
          econstructor; try eassumption; [ rewrite List.length_map; assumption | exact (IH s' φ Hok (env_dbd_nil _) Has) ]
      end end ].
A parameter or an argument at its type, and the rest in the environment extended by it.
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_ps _ _ _ _ (_ :: _) _ _ =>
      econstructor;
      [ exact (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ e)
      | apply H; [ exact H1 | apply dbd_nf_dom; [ eapply eval_dbd; eassumption | apply (all_in_head _ _ _ H3) ] ]
      | apply H0; [ exact H1 | apply env_dbd_cons; [ assumption | apply (all_in_head _ _ _ H3) ] | exact (all_in_tail _ _ _ H3) ] ] end ].
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_cargs _ _ _ _ _ _ (ca_arg _ :: _) _ _ =>
      econstructor;
      [ exact (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ e)
      | apply H; [ exact H1 | apply dbd_nf_dom; [ eapply eval_dbd; eassumption | apply (all_in_head _ _ _ H4) ] ]
      | apply H0; [ exact H1 | exact H2 | apply env_dbd_cons; [ assumption | apply (all_in_head _ _ _ H4) ]
                  | exact (all_in_tail _ _ _ H4) ] ] end ].
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_cargs _ _ _ _ _ _ (ca_rec _ :: _) _ _ =>
      econstructor;
      [ apply H; [ exact H1 | exact H2 | exact H3 | apply (all_in_head _ _ _ H4) ]
      | apply H0; [ exact H1 | exact H2 | exact H3 | exact (all_in_tail _ _ _ H4) ] ] end ].

          let Hss := fresh "Hss" in let Hfx := fresh "Hfx" in let Hnm' := fresh "Hnm" in

          pose proof (Hnm _ Hl) as Hnm';
          pose proof (fresh_tele_length _ _ _ _ f0) as Hl1; rewrite List.length_rev in Hl1;
          change (List.length (im_nparams Mv)) with (im_nn Mv) in Hl1; rewrite Hnn in Hl1;

                                                  | intros; eapply dbd_mono; [| apply Hihs; eassumption ]; lia ]);

          | let H' := fresh in pose proof (eval_args_rn _ _ _ _ e0) as H'; rewrite !List.map_app in H'; exact H'
          | let H' := fresh in pose proof (eval_args_rn _ _ _ _ e1) as H'; rewrite List.map_app in H';

              apply all_in_app; [ intros; eapply dbd_mono; [| apply Hns; eassumption ]; lia |];

            | eapply (HBs c n0 B (or_introl eq_refl)); [ lia | | | exact e0 ]; [ rewrite !length_app, Hl1, Hl2, Hgl, Hl3; lia |];

A recursive argument at the end of its shape: the member at the renamed parameters.
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_shape _ _ _ _ _ _ (pt_self _ _) _ _ =>
      match goal with
      | e : ⟦ ?Ps ⟧* _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?ρ ↘ ?bs, IH : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> dbd_nf ?s _ -> read_nf _ _ s0 _ _,
        Hok : rn_ok f ?s ?s' ?φ, Hρ : env_dbd ?s ?ρ |- _ =>
          econstructor; [ exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f))) _ _ _ e) |];
          rewrite <- List.map_app; apply (IH s' φ Hok); apply dbd_nf_dom; [| assumption ];
          apply dbd_indty; intros a Ha; apply List.in_app_or in Ha as [Ha | Ha]; [ auto |];
          intros w Hw;
          exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (eval_av Θ Ξ w s))) _ _ _ e None (Hρ w Hw) (proj2 (List.Forall_forall _ _) (fun _ _ => I)) _ Ha)
      end end ].
A recursive argument of a function shape: under the renamed fresh variable of its domain.
    all: try solve [ lazymatch goal with |- read_shape _ _ _ _ _ _ (pt_pi _ _) _ _ =>
      match goal with
      | e : ⟦ ?B ⟧ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?ρ ↘ ?b, e0 : $| ?x & ⇑! ?b ?s | _ ⍮ _ ↘ ?r, Er : $| drn f ?x & _ | _ ⍮ _ ↘ drn f ?r,
        IHA : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f ?s s0 φ0 -> dbd ?s ?b -> read_typ _ _ s0 _ _,
        IHV : forall s0 φ0, rn_ok f (S ?s) s0 φ0 -> _ -> env_dbd (S ?s) (?ρ ↦ _) -> dbd (S ?s) ?r -> _,
        Hok : rn_ok f ?s ?s' ?φ, Hok1 : rn_ok f (S ?s) (S ?s') _, Hf0 : f ?s = ?s',
        Hρ : env_dbd ?s ?ρ, Hu : forall a, In a ?ups -> dbd ?s a, Hx : dbd ?s ?x |- _ =>
          let Hbd := fresh "Hbd" in
          assert (Hbd : dbd s b) by (eapply eval_dbd; eassumption);
          econstructor; [ exact (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ e) | exact (IHA s' φ Hok Hbd) | exact Er |];
          change (ern f (ρ ↦ ⇑! b s)) with (ern f ρ ↦ drn f (⇑! b s)) in IHV; cbn [drn drn_ne] in IHV; rewrite Hf0 in IHV;
          apply (IHV (S s') (wk_q φ) Hok1);
          [ intros; eapply dbd_mono; [| apply Hu; eassumption ]; lia
          | apply env_dbd_cons; [ eapply env_dbd_mono; [| exact Hρ ]; lia | apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | exact Hbd ] ]
          | eapply dbd_app; [ exact e0 | eapply dbd_mono; [| exact Hx ]; lia | apply dbd_fresh; [ lia | exact Hbd ] ] ]
      end end ].
    all: econstructor.
    all: try rewrite <- nf_lvl_of_wk.
    all: try eassumption.
    all: match goal with
         | IH : _ |- _ => solve [ eapply IH; [ eassumption | dbd_solve ] ]
         end.
  Qed.

  Corollary read_nf_rn : forall s s' φ m W,
      rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd_nf s m ->
      Rnf m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s ↘ W -> Rnf drn_nf f m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ nf_wk φ W.
  Proof. intros * ? ? H; eapply (proj1 read_rn); eassumption. Qed.

  Corollary read_typ_rn : forall s s' φ a A,
      rn_ok f s s' φ -> dbd s a ->
      Rtyp a in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s ↘ A -> Rtyp drn f a in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ s' ↘ nf_wk φ A.
  Proof. intros * ? ? H; eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 read_rn))); eassumption. Qed.
End Read.

Readback Shift

The renaming that makes room for one more variable at level s: the levels below s stay, the others move up by one. It fixes the initial environment of a context of length s and every value evaluated in it, and it corresponds to ↑ on indices. So the value of a term of Γ reads back at |Γ| + 1 as the weakening of what it reads back as at |Γ|.
Definition lvl_shift_above (s : nat) : nat -> nat := fun x => if x <? s then x else S x.

Lemma rn_ok_shift : forall s, rn_ok (lvl_shift_above s) s (S s) wk_shift.
Proof.
  intros s; unfold lvl_shift_above; constructor.
  - lia.
  - intros x Hx; destruct (Nat.ltb_spec x s); lia.
  - intros x Hx; destruct (Nat.ltb_spec x s); lia.
  - intros x Hx; destruct (Nat.ltb_spec x s); cbn [wk_shift]; lia.
  - apply wk_mono_shift.
Qed.

A renaming that fixes the levels of a context fixes its initial environment.
Lemma initial_env_rn : forall Θ Ξ Γ ρ,
    initial_env Θ Ξ Γ ρ ->
    forall f, (forall x, x < List.length Γ -> f x = x) -> ern f ρ = ρ.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros f Hf; cbn [List.length] in Hf; [ reflexivity | | |].
  all: assert (Hρ : ern f ρ = ρ) by (apply IHinitial_env; intros; apply Hf; lia).
  - pose proof (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ H0) as Ha; rewrite Hρ in Ha.
    assert (drn f a = a) as Ea by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    cbn [extend_env ern List.map dern drn drn_ne]; fold (ern f ρ).
    rewrite Hρ, Ea, Hf by lia; reflexivity.
  - pose proof (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ H0) as Hm; rewrite Hρ in Hm.
    assert (drn f m = m) as Em by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    cbn [extend_env ern List.map dern]; fold (ern f ρ).
    rewrite Hρ, Em; reflexivity.
  - pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f))))) _ _ _ H0) as Hh; rewrite Hρ in Hh.
    assert (dmrn f h = h) as Eh by (eapply functional_eval_modexp; eassumption).
    cbn [extend_env_mod ern List.map dern]; fold (ern f ρ); rewrite Hρ, Eh; reflexivity.
Qed.

Corollary eval_initial_rn : forall Θ Ξ Γ ρ M m,
    initial_env Θ Ξ Γ ρ -> ⟦ M ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ m ->
    forall f, (forall x, x < List.length Γ -> f x = x) -> drn f m = m.
Proof.
  intros * Hρ Hm f Hf.
  pose proof (proj1 (eval_rn Θ Ξ f) _ _ _ Hm) as Hm'.
  rewrite (initial_env_rn _ _ _ _ Hρ f Hf) in Hm'.
  eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption.
Qed.

A value of the initial environment mentions only the levels of the context.
Lemma eval_initial_dbd : forall Θ Ξ Γ ρ M m,
    initial_env Θ Ξ Γ ρ -> ⟦ M ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ m -> dbd (List.length Γ) m.
Proof.
  intros * Hρ Hm v Hv.
  apply (proj1 (eval_av Θ Ξ v (List.length Γ)) _ _ _ Hm None); [| exact I ].
  eapply initial_env_av; [ exact Hρ | exact Hv | reflexivity ].
Qed.

Lemma lvl_shift_above_lt : forall s x, x < s -> lvl_shift_above s x = x.
Proof. intros; unfold lvl_shift_above; destruct (Nat.ltb_spec x s); lia. Qed.

Readback shift: a value of Γ reads back one variable further out as the weakening of its normal form.
Theorem read_shift : forall Θ Ξ Γ ρ A M a m W,
    initial_env Θ Ξ Γ ρ ->
    ⟦ A ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ a ->
    ⟦ M ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ m ->
    Rnf ⇓ a m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ List.length Γ ↘ W ->
    Rnf ⇓ a m in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ S (List.length Γ) ↘ nf_wk ↑ W.
Proof.
  intros * Hρ Ha Hm HW.
  pose proof (read_nf_rn Θ Ξ (lvl_shift_above (List.length Γ)) _ _ _ _ _ (rn_ok_shift _)
                (dbd_nf_dom _ _ _ (eval_initial_dbd _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha) (eval_initial_dbd _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Hm)) HW)
    as HW'.
  cbn [drn_nf] in HW'.
  rewrite (eval_initial_rn _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha _ (lvl_shift_above_lt _)),
    (eval_initial_rn _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Hm _ (lvl_shift_above_lt _)) in HW'.
  exact HW'.
Qed.

Theorem read_typ_shift : forall Θ Ξ Γ ρ A a W,
    initial_env Θ Ξ Γ ρ ->
    ⟦ A ⟧ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ρ ↘ a ->
    Rtyp a in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ List.length Γ ↘ W ->
    Rtyp a in Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ S (List.length Γ) ↘ nf_wk ↑ W.
Proof.
  intros * Hρ Ha HW.
  pose proof (read_typ_rn Θ Ξ (lvl_shift_above (List.length Γ)) _ _ _ _ _ (rn_ok_shift _)
                (eval_initial_dbd _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha) HW) as HW'.
  rewrite (eval_initial_rn _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha _ (lvl_shift_above_lt _)) in HW'.
  exact HW'.
Qed.
